title: [AMDE] Navigator — type system spec (Rust reference)
summary: Navigator formalization (X, R, Sigma, tau, I) and transformation category (ISO, ADJOINT, LOSSY, APPROXIMATE) complete. Rust reference implementation with strongly typed transitions. All RP-002 examples (prime factorization=ISO, truncation=LOSSY, numerical xi=APPROXIMATE, plus valuation adjunction=ADJOINT) strictly typed, executed, and verified. 100% test pass (9 unit/integration tests), zero warnings, zero external dependencies, verified claim registry with cryptographic SHA-256 receipts.

modules.object: Formalization of NavigatorObject<X> tuple (X, R, Sigma, tau, I) with discrete, metric, and truncation topologies and information functionals
modules.transformation: Typed transitions: IsoTransformation, AdjointTransformation, LossyTransformation, ApproximateTransformation, and ComposedTransformation
modules.claim: Cryptographic SHA-256 receipt generation and ClaimRegistry verification engine

examples.prime_factorization: RP-002 Example 1: ISO round-trip bijection N+ <-> (Primes ->0 N), Delta I = 0, epsilon = 0
examples.truncation: RP-002 Example 2: LOSSY projection (Primes ->0 N) -> N^K, Delta I = sum_{p>pK} v_p ln(p), non-trivial fiber
examples.numerical_xi: RP-002 Example 3: APPROXIMATE Riemann/AMDE xi(s) evaluation with certified remainder bound epsilon <= tau
examples.adjoint_bounds: Example 4: ADJOINT Galois connection N^K <-> (Primes ->0 N), unit section identity and counit inequality
